epics.title: Python rewrite 2.0: FastMCP + Agent/Search/Embeddings APIs
epics.description: Parent release epic. Full rewrite in Python (uv, src/ layout, FastMCP, pydantic, SQLAlchemy+Alembic, pytest, ruff pre-commit). Moves off deprecated Sonar (support ended 2026-09-27) to the Agent API; adds Search, Embeddings, Decisions. Clean slate, no data import.

epics.title: Model routing: pick cheapest adequate model per request
epics.description: Parent epic for routing. Own decision matrix chooses preset/model per prompt; escalates on complexity; optionally uses Perplexity Decisions API as classifier. Not in 2.0 (2.0 ships explicit depth param). Savings target unverified; measured in routing-eval-tuning.

epics.title: Foundation: uv/src layout, ruff+pytest pre-commit, CI, FastMCP app, settings, httpx client, SQLAlchemy+Alembic base, pm2 swap
epics.description: uv project, src/ layout, ruff line-length 100, pytest in pyproject, .pre-commit-config.yaml (ruff-check --fix, ruff-format, local pytest hook), CI running the same, pydantic-settings, async httpx client with live-probe-shaped models (extra=allow), SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Alembic 0001_ base, health endpoint, pm2 on port 8102 /mcp. Live-probe /v1/agent and old async path first.

epics.title: Agent API tools: ask, research (background), chat, jobs

links.reason: needs project scaffold, client, DB base

epics.description: Replace Sonar with POST /v1/agent. depth param maps to presets fast/low/medium/high (xhigh opt-in); explicit model allowed. research uses background mode + GET /v1/agent/{id} + cancel. Chat persisted in SQLite. Citations rebuilt from search_results output items.

epics.title: Search API tool with full filter set

links.reason: needs project scaffold, client, DB base

epics.description: POST /search: multi-query, dates (MM/DD/YYYY), language, domain allow/deny, recency, country, max_tokens, search_type web|fast|people. Structured JSON results. Resolve page-snippets endpoint if one is documented.

epics.title: Per-call cost and usage log

links.reason: needs project scaffold, client, DB base

epics.description: Persist usage.cost per call (tokens, tool costs, preset/model, latency) in SQLite; usage tool reports spend. Feedback data that model-routing needs.

notes.text: lane: openspec not superpowers (routed) — the usage table is an accumulation table persisting external API data; a spec and Gate 1/2 are the durable record (asymmetric tie-break)

epics.title: Embeddings tool with local vector store and semantic search

links.reason: needs project scaffold, client, DB base

epics.description: pplx-embed models, base64 int8/binary decode, local storage, semantic search over saved chats/reports. Never return raw vectors to the model.

epics.title: Decisions API tool (decide)

links.reason: needs project scaffold, client, DB base

epics.description: Thin wrapper over POST /v1/decisions (noul/choice/score questions), question-count cap, no image support in v1.

notes.text: lane: openspec not superpowers (routed) — new tool surface with cost accounting; spec + gates give the durable record

epics.title: Deterministic complexity matrix selects preset (depth=auto)
epics.description: Rules-based classifier (prompt length, task type, tool needs) picking fast/low/medium/high; runs only when depth=auto.

epics.title: Use Perplexity Decisions API as routing classifier
epics.description: Send prompt as state with choice/score questions about complexity; $0.02/1M tokens; adds one network hop and is rate-limited to 10 req/s per org.

epics.title: Escalate to higher tier on incomplete or low-confidence result
epics.description: Retry one tier up when status is incomplete or classifier confidence is low; bounded retries; cost-logged.

epics.title: Measure routing savings and quality against always-high baseline
epics.description: Labeled prompt set plus usage log. The only place a savings number gets claimed. No headline percentage before this runs.

epics.title: Perplexity Router API as an open-model backend
epics.description: Private preview, access requested. Routes to open-weight models only. Blocked until access is granted.
